mapper.sql: select d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.leader_user_id, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.dept_type, d.legal_entity_id, (select le.legal_entity_name from sys_legal_entity le where le.legal_entity_id = d.legal_entity_id limit 1) as legal_entity_name, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time from sys_dept d
mapper.select: where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type = 'STORE' order by d.parent_id, d.order_num
where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type = 'WAREHOUSE' order by d.parent_id, d.order_num

inner join sys_dept current_dept on current_dept.dept_id = #{scopeDeptId} inner join sys_dept scope_root on scope_root.dept_id = cast( case when current_dept.ancestors is null or current_dept.ancestors = '' or current_dept.ancestors = '0' then current_dept.dept_id when current_dept.ancestors like '0,%' then substring_index(substring_index(current_dept.ancestors, ',', 2), ',', -1) else substring_index(current_dept.ancestors, ',', 1) end as unsigned ) where current_dept.del_flag = '0' and current_dept.status = '0' and current_dept.dept_type = 'STORE' and scope_root.del_flag = '0' and scope_root.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type = 'WAREHOUSE' and cast( case when d.ancestors is null or d.ancestors = '' or d.ancestors = '0' then d.dept_id when d.ancestors like '0,%' then substring_index(substring_index(d.ancestors, ',', 2), ',', -1) else substring_index(d.ancestors, ',', 1) end as unsigned ) = scope_root.dept_id order by d.parent_id, d.order_num

inner join sys_dept current_dept on current_dept.dept_id = #{scopeDeptId} inner join sys_dept scope_root on scope_root.dept_id = cast( case when current_dept.ancestors is null or current_dept.ancestors = '' or current_dept.ancestors = '0' then current_dept.dept_id when current_dept.ancestors like '0,%' then substring_index(substring_index(current_dept.ancestors, ',', 2), ',', -1) else substring_index(current_dept.ancestors, ',', 1) end as unsigned ) where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type = 'STORE' and (d.dept_id = scope_root.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_root.dept_id, d.ancestors)) order by d.parent_id, d.order_num
where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') order by d.parent_id, d.order_num

where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE')
and ( d.dept_id in
#{deptId}
or exists ( select 1 from sys_dept scope where scope.del_flag = '0' and scope.status = '0' and scope.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and scope.dept_id in
#{deptId}
and ( find_in_set(scope.dept_id, d.ancestors) or find_in_set(d.dept_id, scope.ancestors) ) ) )
and 1 = 0
order by d.parent_id, d.order_num

where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE')
and d.dept_id in
#{deptId}
and 1 = 0
order by d.parent_id, d.order_num

select count(1) from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE')
and d.dept_id in
#{deptId}
and 1 = 0
select count(1) from sys_user where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from sys_dept where del_flag = '0' and parent_id = #{deptId} limit 1
select * from sys_dept where find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)
select count(*) from sys_dept where status = 0 and del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)
where dept_name=#{deptName} and parent_id = #{parentId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_dept( dept_id, parent_id, dept_name, ancestors, order_num, leader, leader_user_id, phone, email, status, dept_type, legal_entity_id, create_by, create_time )values( #{deptId}, #{parentId}, #{deptName}, #{ancestors}, #{orderNum}, #{leader}, #{leaderUserId}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{deptType}, #{legalEntityId}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update sys_dept set status = '0' where dept_id in
#{deptId}
update sys_dept set order_num = #{orderNum} where dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.delete: update sys_dept set del_flag = '2' where dept_id = #{deptId}
